reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, retrying on the error instead of keeping a list of reasoning-model names is the right shape, it won't go stale.

Checked at `648180b`: `rejectsSamplingParams` only matches a 400 whose `Param` is `temperature` or `top_p`, the retry happens once, and zeroing both fields drops them from the body because go-openai tags them `omitempty` (your tests assert exactly that). Models that accept the values never see a second request, and any other error comes back unchanged. CI is green.

Heads-up: #1870 edits the same `ChatCompletionRequest` literal in `pkg/ai/openai.go` (the `MaxCompletionTokens` line you realigned here), so whichever of the two lands second will need a quick rebase.

Good to merge.
